episode_title: Your Ads Aren’t the Problem. Your Product Photos Are.

real_qa.q: What are the three pillars PhotoRoom uses to evaluate product pages in its PhotoRoom 100 ranking?
real_qa.r: The three pillars are product fidelity, which builds trust with accurate details of the item; visual realism, which ensures the image looks like the actual item; and gallery complete, which is a gallery that converts by telling everything you need to know so you don't have to read descriptions.

real_qa.q: How did PhotoRoom improve AI image generation success rates from 29% to 80% through its QA process?
real_qa.r: PhotoRoom starts with 29% of images coming out good enough from AI models, then goes through a QA loop to look at failures and regenerate those, bringing success to approximately 40%, then adding another 10% in the next generation cycle, reaching 80% success versus the initial 60% failure rate. PhotoRoom processes millions of images daily across 7 billion images per year.
real_qa.requete: PhotoRoom QA loop AI image generation 29% 80%

real_qa.q: What conversion lift did a Shopify customer achieve after PhotoRoom improved 25 product images using the product page rater?
real_qa.r: A customer using PhotoRoom's dogfooding project saw a 71% gain in add-to-basket rate on the specific improved items, which drove a giant lift in overall sales, prompting her to begin revamping hundreds of items across her entire Shopify store.
real_qa.requete: PhotoRoom product page rater 71% add to basket conversion

real_qa.q: Why do most Shopify brands neglect improving their product detail pages despite heavy ad spending?
real_qa.r: Brands are moving very fast and don't allocate enough time and resources to ensure product pages receive the importance they deserve. Investing in professional product photography or dedicated resources, or at minimum slowing down to prioritize quality, distinguishes top brands from the rest.
real_qa.requete: why Shopify brands neglect product page optimization

real_qa.q: What is the difference between PhotoRoom's Video Generator and Video Ad Maker tools?
real_qa.r: Video Generator creates product videos that show images at the PDP level for informational purposes, while Video Ad Maker runs through several prompts to understand your brand and automatically generates videos formatted for Meta, YouTube, TikTok, and other major platforms.
real_qa.requete: PhotoRoom Video Generator vs Video Ad Maker
